item: map the R3 and R4 evidence precisely: which profile means what, what the cache rerun actually covers, and which counts must not be read as equivalents

the_seven_named_tests.profile: migration/required-tests.json - the current round's named profile: 4 tests in pkg/localdeps/go-utils/trans and 3 in pkg/jwt
the_seven_named_tests.checker_run: go test -count=1 -p 2 -json over exactly those two packages, then tools/migration/require_tests.py; result pass=true, required=7, bad_tests=[], failed_packages=[]
the_seven_named_tests.what_it_is_not: it is not 'the whole repository's tests' and is never reported as such: it covers seven specific names that were the ones this round had to name explicitly

mandatory_items_already_inside_the_full_.how_mapped: one fresh go test -count=1 -json over the gate's own untagged package list (data, service, server, ./pkg/...), then each archived profile checked against that single log with require_tests.py
mandatory_items_already_inside_the_full_.explanation_of_the_not_executed_entries: every one of them is an id case that T10 itself moved behind the upstream_known_defects build tag (TestGenerateOrderIdWithTenantIdCollision, TestGenerateOrderIdWithIndexThread, TestGenerateOrderIdWithRandom), so by design they cannot appear in a default-tag run. The archived profiles predate that isolation and were never re-generated, which is inventory drift in the archived file, not a missing test. Those three names are verified where they belong: the tagged run in migration/patches/T15/T15-r3c-id-known-defects.json.
mandatory_items_already_inside_the_full_.no_new_exclusion: no profile was edited, trimmed or re-baselined to reach these results

cache_reconciliation.method: package-by-package set comparison of ok lines with their cached flag, not a comparison of line counts
cache_reconciliation.gate_log: r4c-verify-gpu.log: 74 ok lines, 70 distinct packages, 67 cached, 7 fresh; internal/data and internal/service each appear three times because they also run under -tags quota_pg and under -race
cache_reconciliation.rerun: r4c-nocache.log: 69 distinct packages, zero cached, exit 0
cache_reconciliation.coverage_result: cached packages not covered by the -count=1 rerun: NONE. Packages in the rerun that the gate did not have: NONE.
cache_reconciliation.the_single_difference: go-wind-admin/app/admin/service/internal/quotalab/simulator is in the gate but not in the rerun, and it was itself executed with -count=1 inside scripts/accelerator-acceptance/lab-regression.sh, so it was never a cached result
cache_reconciliation.cache_not_purged: the shared Go build and test cache was left intact; the fresh run used -count=1, not a cache clear

gitleaks_wording.correct_statement: 0 unresolved findings, with two reviewed per-value exceptions in the tree: the T14 buildinfo dirhash pair recorded in migration/patches/T15/T15-gitleaks-exception.json and the earlier reviewed exceptions already in .gitleaks.toml
gitleaks_wording.incorrect_statement_to_avoid: it was never 'no leaks were ever found': run r4b reported leaks found: 2 and that log is kept
gitleaks_wording.final_state: gitleaks dir over 8668362 reports no leaks found, and scripts/gitleaks-buildinfo-exception.sh still proves the exception cannot spread

known_defect_wording.captcha: 9 cases, each a real fail with assertion site and transcript matching the pristine locked copy: KNOWN_BASELINE_FAILURE, recorded in migration/patches/T15/T15-r3c-captcha-known-defects.json
